nameEn: Manufacture of other articles of paper and paperboard
description: This class includes the manufacture of other articles of paper and paperboard not elsewhere classified.
includes: manufacture of paper stationery: notebooks, exercise books, diaries, envelopes
manufacture of wallpaper and similar wall coverings
manufacture of carbon paper, self-copy paper and other copying or transfer papers
manufacture of sanitary paper products: toilet paper, handkerchiefs, tissues, paper towels, napkins
manufacture of paper or paperboard tableware: cups, plates, trays
manufacture of filter paper and paperboard
manufacture of paper and paperboard office and school supplies
excludes: manufacture of pulp, paper and paperboard, see 1701
manufacture of corrugated paper containers, see 1702
